property_summary: For any recipient and reward amount, if withdrawReward is called and the external transfer succeeds, the reference contract always clears rewardsForA[recipient] to 0 afterwards; the mutant that omits zeroing can leave a non-zero stored reward when the external call reverts, so using a callee that reverts will make the mutant differ.
change_summary: Remove the line that zeroes the stored reward before the external call, so stored reward remains unchanged after withdrawReward.
